problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$

activity_context.topic_title: Expressing the Coordinates of a Vector in a Given Basis
